gaps: The EEVblog post describes no internal parts.
No model number is given on any of the three pages, so only the DELTA Pro name is used.
method: StorageReview's DELTA Pro review gives a 3.6 kWh LiFePO4 battery, 3600 W total pure-sine AC output (surge 7200 W) and a 1600 W solar input.
The EcoFlow product page names the DELTA Pro with a 3.6 kWh base capacity, LiFePO4 chemistry, 1600 W solar input and up to 4500 W of appliances with X-Boost.
The EEVblog 1499 post names the EcoFlow Delta Pro 3.6 kWh LiFePO4 unit.

comps.spec: LiFePO4 battery, 3.6 kWh (3,600 Wh). Cycle life 6,500 cycles to 50% capacity and 3,500 cycles to 80% capacity; shelf life 1 year. The reviewers' discharge test at a 350 W load measured 3,000 Wh.

Pure sine wave AC output (x5): 3,600 W total, surge 7,200 W; review says it can maintain continuous loads of 3,600 W. X-Boost supports devices up to 4,500 W. Sockets: four 20 A AC outlets and one 30 A AC port.
Solar charging input: 1,600 W max, 11-150 V, 15 A max.
